findings.title: User notification preferences are recorded but never delivered
evidence: docs/runbooks/INCIDENT.md:46 ntfy.sh is the sole outbound transport (operator alerts)
No email/push sender or delivery log in the repository
findings.impact: Preferences imply a delivery promise the product does not yet fulfil; users cannot receive or disable channel-specific notices.
findings.recommendation: Either label preferences as 'future' in the UI or implement a delivery path with opt-in, retry, and a delivery log.

report: Notification preferences are stored per user (privacy notice section 'Social'), but user-facing delivery channels are not implemented: the only outbound transport is operator alerting via ntfy.sh (docs/runbooks/INCIDENT.md, infra/ops/crontab). There is no email/push sender to audit for replay, retry, or opt-in enforcement.
